intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: A self-writing quill is reviewing the announcement Tavri just made. It has opinions.

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “Five stars for my pronunciation. One star for the actual message.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “Savaged by stationery. There’s a footnote about my vowels.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “That the palace servants should get a day off. The quill found the topic ‘a little worthy.’”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: The quill adds a line: *Princess now glaring at reviewer. Two stars.*

options.labelText: “Has anyone asked the servants which day they want?”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “No. We announced it *at* them. Beautifully, apparently.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “Come on, let’s go and ask. The quill can review the walk.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: The quill writes *Unexpected. Three stars,* and hurries after you.

options.labelText: “Easy fix. Next time, make the announcement more dazzling.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “More dazzling. A harp, perhaps. Some doves.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: The quill gives the doves five stars. Tavri doesn’t read it.
